title: Qwen3-VL GT-direct teacher-only real-tool reachability pilot
purpose: On the four non-trivial 0803 episodes, hold the fresh SAM3 initial state, real SAM3/SimpleClick executors, max_steps=3 and endpoint fixed, then replace production proposal geometry with GT-derived error-component geometry to separate proposal coverage from the bounded tool/gate ceiling.

scope_and_access_audit.limitation: LEVIR-CD supplies change GT but no T1/T2 building GT. This pilot can test change-mask controllability only. The full teacher proposal, including GT-derived error metadata, is stored in Environment evidence. The Executor and receipt also see geometry, ROI/area and a teacher-encoded authorized region ID; the SAM3/SimpleClick backends see only real-call geometry and localized current-mask context, never the raw GT mask or path. These artifacts are not deployable trajectories or SFT data.

execution_protocol.track_start_policy: Every executed track starts from a fresh SAM3 Environment and must match the preregistered T1/T2/change mask hashes.
execution_protocol.selection_policy: Execute the frozen candidate batch without raw GT pixels in any tool call; offline GT then selects the eligible result with greatest pixel-error reduction, breaking ties by candidate_id.

strict_metric_improvement.nonempty_gt: IoU and F1 must both strictly increase

teacher_geometry.component_order: pixel_count descending, then error kind FN before FP, then top/left coordinate
teacher_geometry.point_policy: Choose the component interior pixel with maximum distance to its boundary; break ties by y then x. Match the frozen production executor surface: enumerate a SimpleClick positive point on either live polarity (add or refine), and additionally enumerate a negative point when the live target pixel is foreground.
teacher_geometry.box_policy: Use the inclusive component bounding box, clip deterministic proportional padding to the 256x256 crop, and enumerate SAM3 box on both target views.

interpretation_rule.matched_safe_endpoint_4_of_4: The matched GT geometry rescues all four production failures under the same tool, hard gate, RGB gate and step budget; production Proposal/geometry/shortlist is a demonstrated primary pilot bottleneck, though not necessarily the only bottleneck.
interpretation_rule.wide_safe_only_rescue: Tool plus production safety gates can reach the endpoint, but a wider geometry search is needed; Proposal geometry or candidate coverage is a demonstrated bottleneck.
interpretation_rule.wide_hard_only_rescue: The real tools and production hard gate can reach the endpoint; the frozen RGB routing/gate blocks the safe track.
interpretation_rule.wide_raw_only_rescue: The real tools can produce a three-step improving trajectory, but the production hard gate blocks it.
interpretation_rule.wide_raw_failure: The bounded greedy teacher search did not find an endpoint under the current real tools, frozen MaskPairProcessor composition, four GT error components, frozen geometry family and max_steps=3; this does not isolate a tool-only ceiling and must not be attributed solely to Proposal.
interpretation_rule.mixed_samples: Report mixed bottlenecks per sample and do not force a binary global label.

artifact_plan.attempt_policy: append-only first absent attempt-NNNN; never overwrite or merge partial attempts

formal_execution.revision_scope: test-only contract assertion regex; scientific protocol unchanged
formal_execution.self_reference_policy: Job IDs and observed results are intentionally absent from this frozen preregistration and are recorded only in append-only submission, worker and validation receipts.
